The '''Farseen system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] where the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] maintained a base. While New Republic and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] troops clashed, the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] unit [[Star's Nova]], led by [[Qell Tepine]], penetrated the base's command center and disabled the perimeter weapons. The Empire was able to take the base.
